description: This file is a shell script for testing the integrity and consistency of git references, refs, tags, and packed-refs files within a git repository. It contains multiple test cases to verify ref name formats, content correctness, symlink consistency, packed-refs file structure, and fsck options handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_expect_success SYMLINKS
methods.description: Defines a test case involving symbolic links, particularly for symlinked refs and obj files.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to be executed after the test.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a certain command produces no output (empty output).

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a certain command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the repository (assumed from context).

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the repository.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Checks out a branch or commit.

methods.name: git refs verify
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of refs in the repository.

methods.name: git update-ref
methods.description: Updates a ref to point to a specific object.

methods.name: git rev-parse
methods.description: Parses and returns references or object ids.

methods.name: git fsck
methods.description: Verifies the connectivity and validity of objects in the repository.

methods.name: ln -sf
methods.description: Creates symbolic links, used here to test symlink-based ref content.
